title: Infrastructure and Enterprise Engineer III
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Role summary**

  

We are looking for a Infrastructure \& Enterprise Engineer III to join the Reliability Operations. This role is built for a hands\-on engineer with strong coding depth who can improve reliability through automation, AI enablement, and modern platform engineering practices.
  

This team is moving from reactive operations to autonomous resilience, with a clear focus on AI\-enabled detection, response, communication, and prevention, plus automation that reduces manual effort and improves recovery speed. The role should help advance operational excellence through better workflows, stronger observability, and scalable engineering foundations across production systems.


**What you will do**

  

* Design and build workflow automation that removes toil, improves operational consistency, and accelerates incident response
* Develop AI\-enabled operational capabilities that improve detection, diagnosis, communication, and recovery workflows
* Build and maintain services, tools, and automations using Python as a primary engineering language
* Use platforms like n8n and adjacent automation tooling to orchestrate operational workflows across systems
* Strengthen observability across metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and service health signals
* Partner with SRE, platform, infrastructure, and service owners to improve

resilience, MTTR, and engineering standards
  

* Identify repeatable failure patterns and turn them into durable automation,

guardrails, and self\-healing opportunities
  

* Contribute to DevOps practices including CI/CD, release reliability, infrastructure automation, and production readiness
* Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code quality, operational rigor, and mentoring of other engineers.
* Eliminate manual steps in recurring operations processes AI enablement
* Apply AI to operational workflows such as summarization, triage assistance,

intelligent routing, runbook guidance, anomaly context, and post\-incident analysis  

  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

  

* Software design and hands\-on implementation experience
* 8\+ years of experience in reliability engineering and automation
* Strong Python development skills, including building automation frameworks,

services, APIs, and production\-grade tooling
  

* Strong experience with workflow automation, including event\-driven and API\-led integrations
* Deep understanding of observability, including logs, metrics, traces, alerting

strategy, and operational telemetry
  

* Strong DevOps background, including CI/CD, infrastructure automation, production support, and release reliability
* Experience working in high\-availability or mission\-critical environments
* Strong debugging, systems thinking, and incident management instincts
* Ability to work cross\-functionally and influence technical direction.
**Preferred qualifications**

  

* Experience with AIOps, operational intelligence, or AI/LLM\-enabled engineering workflows
* Familiarity with incident management, problem management, and post\-incident review practices
* Experience integrating across tools used in enterprise operations ecosystems
* Knowledge of SRE practices such as SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and reliability

engineering tradeoffs
  

* Experience mentoring engineers and leading medium\-to\-large technical initiatives
* Exposure to cloud\-native infrastructure, platform engineering, and resilience

automation patterns
**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.  



  

**Introduction to team**

The Lodging connectivity Organization at Expedia Group is seeking an experienced backend developer and a seasoned technologist with a passion for building robust, scalable, and high\-performance applications that help millions of people plan their travels and create lifelong memories. Join us as we revolutionize the travel industry!  

  



The organization owns a core lever of Expedia Group's growth: expanding global lodging supply and making it a source of competitive advantage. We build and operate the platform that sources, normalizes, and serves third\-party lodging inventory — powering the shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys that travelers rely on every day. Through resilient API integrations and AI agentic workflows, we bring diverse partner content onto a single platform and make it competitive, accurate, and bookable at scale.


We are part of the partner connectivity platform that serves as the backbone of Expedia's business, powering an efficient two\-way marketplace that bridges supply and demand. Our platform sources properties and handles more than 3M transactions per minute. Built with modern technologies like Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Kafka, DynamoDB, ML, Elasticsearch, and Redis on AWS, our ecosystem supports millions of travelers in finding the best travel products tailored to their needs.  

  



If you're passionate about creating transformative solutions, tackling large\-scale engineering challenges, and shaping the future of lodging supply, we'd love to have you on our team. Join us, and let's redefine the way the world travels together!  

  



**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and evolve scalable, reliable services and software components, including system design, low\-level design, API design, and data modeling to support customer\-facing and platform experiences.
* Lead the technical design across domains and delivery of complex, multi\-quarter initiatives across the 3PI supply system that support shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of complex features or services, from technical design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement in production.
* Break down large, ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions that can be reused across multiple domains and services, driving streamlined execution by the team.
* Write, review, and maintain high\-quality, well\-tested code while driving best practices in code quality, security, observability, resilience, and performance.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by reducing incidents, enhancing observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve traveler and business outcomes, applying AI\-driven systems, tools, and workflows to production\-grade software.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and architecture, and raising the overall engineering bar for the team.
* Partner with product, analytics, design, and engineering teams to apply data\-driven decision making, define success metrics, and improve system health and user outcomes over time.
* Contribute to architectural direction by participating in design reviews, proposing improvements, leading communities of practice, and helping shape long\-term technical strategy.
Technologies we use: Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Docker, Kafka, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Redis, Datadog, Splunk, and AWS cloud.  
* 

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 10\+ years of professional, post\-college backend software development experience in an object\-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end\-to\-end delivery for services or components — design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support — within a multi\-service or multi\-domain environment.
* Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures, with a strong command of core engineering practices including object\-oriented design, testing, and version control.
* Hands\-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable, maintainable systems.
* Hands\-on expertise with AI/ML frameworks and tools, and experience applying AI/ML concepts to real\-world products.
* Experience building on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) with sound architectural patterns and scalable, cost\-efficient, production\-quality systems.
Strong communication skills and a highly effective collaborator — able to articulate ideas to teammates, peers, and leaders, support them with data, and incorporate others' feedback to find common ground.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high\-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low\-level designs.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data\-informed tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Experience with partner or third\-party integrations, supply/inventory systems, or high\-volume marketplace platforms.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Experience leading cross\-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI\-assisted development and testing tools.
* A self\-starter who embraces change and is always open to replacing what you built yesterday with something better today.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About dunnhumby**



dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Meijer, Procter \& Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.


**Product**



Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.


**The Role**



The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data\-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.



You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.


**What You'll Be Doing**



You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.


* Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)
* Identify opportunities to improve product performance through data analysis, experimentation and evidence\-based recommendations
* Work closely with Data Engineers and product squads to ensure the right data is captured, modelled and available for meaningful analysis
* Deliver end\-to\-end analytics, from defining requirements and success metrics through to presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders
* Build, maintain and continuously improve product performance dashboards that provide clear, actionable visibility into product health
* Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data\-driven insights and commercial context
* Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
* Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
* Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non\-technical audiences


**What We're Looking For**



You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


* Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics\-focused role within a software or technology environment
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
* Experience working with cross\-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
* Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
* Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision making through data
* Understanding of statistical analysis, product performance measurement and commercial drivers
* Experience on Heap,Fullstory or Amplitude
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification


**What You Can Expect From Us**



We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.



And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process — please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.


**India Benefits**


* Healthcare \& Family Cover: Group Medical Insurance of INR 500,000 for employees and dependents, plus dental and vision cover up to INR 5,000\.
* Protection: Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover with benefit levels linked to employee grade, including disability benefits.
* Retirement \& Wellbeing: Provident Fund, Gratuity, National Pension Scheme access, Indian Health Organisation membership, and confidential employee assistance support.
* Lifestyle \& Flexibility: Office commute support, internet allowance of INR 2,000 per month for blended working, work\-from\-home kit support, subsidised food, and wellbeing resources.
* Recognition \& Extras: Long service awards, Talent Scout referral programme, and family milestone support.
* Time Off \& Family Leave: 25 days holiday plus 10 public holidays, paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off for your birthday.


**Our approach to Flexible Working**



At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.



We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.



For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found(here)

title: Bilingual System Operations Specialist (Japanese)
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

As a Unified Systems Operator at Kyndryl, you'll take on a critical role of monitoring, controlling, and maintaining cutting\-edge systems across our expansive infrastructure environment. You’ll be the key to providing innovative solutions to both technical and business challenges – ensuring seamless operations that push the boundaries of what's possible.
  

  

In this role, you’ll become a trusted advisor to our customers, offering insights into best practices and resource utilization. You’ll be vital in maintaining our infrastructure through monitoring and validating events and or alerts, executing preventative tasks and escalating potential outages or abnormal situations, applying a proactive approach to challenges.
  

  

As a Unified Systems Operator, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with diverse teams and specialists on projects and interact directly with customers to understand their needs – facilitating cohesive and successful partnerships.
  

  

To thrive in this role, you'll need to bring a challenge and detail\-oriented mindset, coupled with the agility and sense of urgency needed in our fast\-paced environment. Join us in shaping the future of technology – where every day is an adventure, and every challenge is an opportunity for growth. Are you ready to redefine what's possible?
  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. Whether you envision your career path progressing in the technical specialist domain as a Technical Leader or migrating into other technical careers such as an Architect or a Systems Reliability Engineer – we have opportunities you won’t find anywhere else.  



  

**Who You Are**

Who You Are
  

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  

  

Required Skills and Experience


* Fluent in Japanese (JLPT N3 or above) and English, both written and verbal.
* Proficiency in IT systems, including networks, hardware, software, and troubleshooting.
* Experienced in handling client communication and negotiations.
* Excellent in Japanese skills both translation and interpretation
* At least 3 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in an IT or technical setting.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills
Hands\-on experience  
* 

  

  

Preferred Skills and Experience
  

* In\-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating Systems
* Experience or technical knowledge of Batch Operations
* Ability to communicate effectively, both verbal and written
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or other related fields
* Windows Server certification
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Key Account Manager-Environment
description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **Job Description**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. We partner with clients to solve the world's most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. We are seeking a client\-focused Key Account Manager to drive strategic account growth, strengthen client relationships, and support the delivery of high\-quality consulting and engineering solutions.


The successful candidate will be responsible for managing strategic accounts, identifying growth opportunities, coordinating cross\-functional teams, and ensuring exceptional client experiences across Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS), Sustainability, Risk Management, and Engineering Consulting projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client \& Account Management**

* Serve as the primary relationship manager for designated key accounts.
* Develop and maintain executive\-level relationships with client stakeholders.
* Understand client business priorities and align service offerings to meet evolving needs.
* Conduct account reviews and develop account growth strategies.

**Business Development \& Growth**

* Identify opportunities for account expansion, cross\-selling, and upselling of consulting and engineering services.
* Support proposal development, client presentations, and commercial discussions.
* Drive revenue growth and contribute to annual business targets.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify emerging opportunities.

**Project \& Delivery Coordination**

* Collaborate closely with technical, project management, environmental, and engineering teams.
* Ensure successful delivery of projects in accordance with client expectations.
* Facilitate communication between clients and internal delivery teams.
* Track project performance, milestones, and customer satisfaction.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build trusted partnerships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Support senior leadership in account planning and strategic decision\-making.
* Lead client meetings, business reviews, and solution workshops.

**Customer Success**

* Proactively address client concerns and escalations.
* Ensure consistently high levels of client satisfaction and retention.
* Gather feedback and recommend improvements to strengthen service delivery.

  

**Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Business Administration, or related field.
* 4\+ years of experience in Key Account Management, Client Services, Consulting Sales, Business Development, or Strategic Account Management.
* Demonstrated experience managing enterprise or strategic client relationships.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building abilities

  

**Additional Information** **Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA in Marketing, Operations, or Business Management.
* Experience in EHS Consulting, Environmental Services, Sustainability, Infrastructure, Engineering, or Risk Management sectors.
* Knowledge of CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
* Experience working in a matrix organization and cross\-functional environment.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic Account Management
* Client Relationship Management
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Business Development
* Commercial Acumen
* Project Coordination
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Solution Selling
* Revenue Growth Management
* Customer Success \& Retention


At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**


You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community \- where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Senior Specialist
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


The **Global Digital Marketing Automation Senior Specialist** is a deep, day\-to\-day expert in Marketo (or an equivalent platform such as Eloqua, Pardot, or HubSpot) who owns and optimizes our marketing automation engine. You’ll manage everything from advanced campaign builds and third\-party integrations to lead lifecycle strategy, event operations, and data governance — acting as the platform’s subject matter expert across the organization.


This is an ideal role for someone who has moved beyond basic email sends and wants to own the architecture, personalization, and performance of a marketing automation instance end\-to\-end.

 **Platform Management \& Campaign Execution**

* Manage, build, and optimize advanced Marketo core assets daily, including Smart Campaigns, Programs, Smart Lists, and flow logic
* Build and maintain universal, advanced Marketo Forms with progressive profiling, UTM parameter capture, hidden fields, and custom JavaScript for use across multiple workspaces
* Design and deploy standard landing page templates integrated with social sharing/network components
* Create reusable snippets for standardized footers and modular content blocks across landing pages and emails

 **Integrations \& Tech Stack**

* Integrate and manage third\-party platforms within Marketo, including webinar/virtual event tools (Zoom, ON24\), event registration platforms (Aventri, Certain), and mobile push notification channels
* Work with CRM platforms such as Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics, ensuring seamless lead/contact flow, field mapping, and sync configuration between Marketo and the CRM
* Troubleshoot CRM–Marketo sync issues (e.g., sync errors, field mismatches, duplicate records, blocked syncs) and implement fixes to maintain reliable, real\-time data flow \- Apply data enrichment practices — using enrichment tools, form\-based progressive profiling, and third\-party data append — to keep lead and contact records complete and up to date
* Demonstrate strong API familiarity, including configuring and managing API user roles/permissions, working with REST APIs for platform integrations, and troubleshooting API\- based data exchanges
* Test new services, integrations, and platform updates prior to launch

**Lead Lifecycle: Nurturing, Scoring \& Personalization**

* Build and maintain lead nurturing and lead scoring programs at both the global/instance level and individual campaign level
* Design and execute web personalization campaigns using dynamic content, web campaigns, and audience segments
* Develop lifecycle models and continuously refine scoring frameworks to improve lead quality and MQL conversion

**Data Management \& Segmentatio****n**

* Define and maintain audience segmentation strategies at both the client/account level and individual project level
* Own database hygiene, list imports, and data quality processes to maintain a clean, actionable database
* Support governance and documentation standards for data usage across programs

**Events \& Content Programs**

* Manage end\-to\-end program setup for trade shows, including personalized agendas and dynamic imagery per attendee/segment
* Build and manage webinar, online event, and gated content programs, including registration, reminder, and follow\-up flows
* Own program status tracking and post\-event hygiene (e.g., processing attendee/lead downloads, deduplication, list cleanup)

**Enablement, Governance \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as subject\-matter expert (SME) for the marketing automation platform, supporting troubleshooting, consultations, and new project readiness
* Provide training and documentation to internal teams, marketing ops representatives, and business stakeholders
* Partner with stakeholders to define requirements, governance standards, and rollout plans for new pilots or workspaces
* Support onboarding of new projects/workspaces onto the platform, including QA and functionality testing

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 4–7 years of hands\-on experience managing a marketing automation platform (Marketo strongly preferred; Eloqua, Pardot, or HubSpot experience also considered)
* Marketo Certified Expert certification preferred (or willingness to obtain)
* Proven experience building advanced Smart Campaigns, Programs, and multi\-step nurture/lead scoring logic
* Experience integrating Marketo with third\-party tools (webinar platforms, event management tools, CRM, mobile/push notification systems)
* Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), including lead/contact sync configuration and troubleshooting CRM–Marketo data flow issues
* Familiarity with data enrichment tools and practices to maintain accurate and complete records
* Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive/media\-query email template design
* Experience with progressive profiling, dynamic/personalized content, and web segmentation
* Solid understanding of database segmentation, list hygiene, and data governance best practices

title: Senior Manager SIOP Planning
description:
### **Role Responsibilities:**


* Own digital product strategy, roadmap, governance, adoption, and value realization for supply chain planning capabilities, including enterprise planning and supply chain technology platforms.
* Partner with SIOP, Manufacturing, Materials, Operations, and Digital stakeholders to align business priorities with technology investments and supply chain capability development.
* Lead end\-to\-end supply chain process transformation across Made\-to\-Stock (MTS), Made\-to\-Order (MTO), and Engineer\-to\-Order (ETO) business \& operating models, driving standardization, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct business process and solution architecture assessments to identify opportunities that improve service, inventory performance, productivity, and operational effectiveness across the value chain.
* Develop inventory optimization strategies, including MEIO (Multi\-Echelon Inventory Optimization), inventory segmentation, safety stock policies, and replenishment methodologies.
* Translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions through collaboration with technology and development teams, leveraging automation, advanced analytics, and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Lead cross\-functional transformation programs and strategic initiatives, ensuring stakeholder alignment, execution discipline, and achievement of business outcomes.
* Drive complexity reduction initiatives, including SKU rationalization, portfolio optimization, planning parameter governance, and supply chain simplification efforts.
* Develop KPI frameworks, dashboards, analytics, business cases, and benefit\-tracking methodologies that support executive decision\-making and value realization.
* Partner with Master Data Management teams to improve data quality, governance, and accessibility across planning and operational systems.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to business and digital leadership by providing strategic recommendations, identifying transformation opportunities, and helping define long\-term business and technology priorities

### **Role Purpose**


* As the Senior Manager, SIOP Digital Partner — Enterprise Planning and Digital Transformation, you will shape and lead Carrier's supply chain planning capability strategy, driving digital transformation across planning, procurement, inventory, and fulfillment operations. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technology execution — translating complex supply chain requirements into scalable digital solutions that improve service, reduce cost, and enable competitive advantage across Carrier's global factory network.

### **Minimum Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Operations, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in supply chain planning, operations, digital transformation, program management, or related disciplines.
* Strong understanding of SIOP/IBP, demand planning, supply planning, inventory management, and manufacturing processes.
* Experience leading cross\-functional business transformation and technology initiatives.
* Experience with enterprise planning and ERP platforms (e.g., Kinaxis, SAP, or similar solutions).
* Ability to translate business requirements into technology\-enabled solutions and drive adoption across stakeholder groups.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders and lead initiatives across business, operations, and technology organizations.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* MBA or advanced degree in a related field.
* Fluency in Mandarin will be preferred
* Experience with Kinaxis, KetteQ, LeanDNA, SAP ECC, and/or SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience with inventory optimization strategies, including MEIO, inventory segmentation, and safety stock methodologies.
* Knowledge of supply chain solution architecture, enterprise system integrations, APIs, master data governance, and data management principles.
* Experience leveraging advanced analytics, automation, AI/ML, or decision intelligence solutions.
* Experience supporting MTS, MTO, and ETO manufacturing environments.
* APICS/ASCM, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or similar professional certification.
